basic_info.description: This quiet, rear bi-level condo exudes elegance and a calming & cohesive aesthetic. Luxe designer wallpapers, custom window treatments & high-end fixtures enhance the refined atmosphere. The front entry, complete with a full bath, seamlessly blends into the open-concept kitchen & flows through to the light-filled great room. The Chef's kitchen has high-end appliances: Miele gas range, Wolf microwave drawer, dishwasher & Subzero refrigerator. Originally built as a 3-bed home, the current layout has 2 bedrooms, with flexibility to easily convert back to its original design. The upstairs bedrooms have been combined to create an expansive primary suite, with a big dressing room w/ custom cabinetry & luxe carpeting, along with a secondary walk-in closet in the primary bedroom. The en-suite bath has Waterworks fixtures, dual vanity & TOTO toilet w/ Washlet. The lower level is used as a home office/guest suite w/ dual workspaces & ample storage. This floor also has a full bath, W/D, & a deeded patio w/ bbq with a gate to the shared yard. Dual-paned windows, tall ceilings & 8ft doors. 1,510 SqFt. Deeded storage & 1 independent parking with internal access via the lobby. Constructed in 2000. Moments to Laurel Village, Sacramento St, JCC, The Presidio & more! See Video preview!
